t.why: In 1957 it was the first country south of the Sahara to win independence. The secretariat of the African free trade area is in its capital, Accra.
t.rel: One of West Africa's most stable democracies. The secretariat of the African Continental Free Trade Area is in its capital, Accra.
t.etext: It sells gold, cocoa and oil. After defaulting on its debt in 2022, it went through a debt restructuring. Political stability makes it a favored investment base in West Africa.
